title: Optimal stochastic impulse control problem with delay with actions decided at the execution time
summary: In this paper, we consider a class of stochastic impulse control problem when there is a fixed delay $Δ$ between the decision and execution times. The dynamics of the controlled system between two impulses is an arbitrary adapted stochastic process. Unlike the most existing literature, we consider the problem when the impulse sizes are decided at the execution time in both risk-neutral and risk-sensitive cases.
